title: Aerial yoga, shared in good company
body: A glimpse of an aerial yoga class in Yangon: shared movement, steady support, and room to explore at your own pace.

photos.alt: Students practicing supported aerial yoga poses together in a bright Yangon studio

title: There is no perfect time to begin
body: You don't need to be flexible, experienced, or ready for anything in particular. Bring the body you have today, take one breath at a time, and let that be enough.

title: Your practice can change with you
body: Some days call for movement. Some days ask for stillness. Paying attention is part of the practice, too—and there is room for both on the mat.

title: A little space that is yours
body: Private sessions offer time to explore yoga in a way that feels personal. We move at your pace and make space for questions, quiet, and whatever you need that day.
